nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 19 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine three independent current-day observations updated at 12:37, 13:00 and 13:29 WAT on 20 Nov, rechecked at 13:36 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
